## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The JSON option works alone, but its default destination fails when followed by the JUnit option. Fix this argument parsing defect before merging.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — With `--json --junit report.xml`, the parser consumes `--junit` as the JSON destination and then raises `unknown option: report.xml`. Only consume the next argument when it is a path rather than another option. — Users cannot request the default JSON destination before a JUnit destination.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- Tests verify explicit JSON file contents and rejection of missing JUnit paths.
